assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE premium game upgrade CARD ILLUSTRATION, portrait 3:5, intended final 720x1200 RGB. Style: richly textured restrained northern myth oil painting / painterly impasto, realistic faces and materials, same collection as attached original portraits, NOT pixel art, NOT anime, no glossy 3D. This is a living myth inside an ancient archive; do not add computers, museums or science-fiction. CRITICAL composition: heads and every key spell, weapon, animal or gesture entirely within upper55% of image; faces around y15-25%, upper bodies around y25-50%; bottom40% deep blue-black simple cloak/shadow fading into quiet negative space for game text. Left/right40px safe margins at final size: no face/important weapon/animal touches side edges. Show a single composed cinematic scene, not a multi-panel sheet. No borders, card frame, letters, readable runes, logos, watermark, interface or typography. Natural anatomy, clearly separated hands, structurally sound weapons, restrained bloom; faces legible at260px wide. Preserve identity, age, hair, facial features, costume materials and painterly style from references; pose and scenario change for THIS specific upgrade.
Subject A identity: the same mature blonde woman with a strong composed face, dark feather cloak, gold necklace and bronze ornaments, pale gold magic.
Subject B identity: the same golden-haired bearded mature man, green and gold clothing under a dark fur mantle, bronze leaf ornaments, warm harvest sunlight.
Specific shared spell scene: The blonde feather-cloaked woman and golden-haired bearded green-clad man stand shoulder to shoulder, ONE floating golden straight sword crosses one curving gold FEATHER blade, gold selection light at their crossing, warm familial solidarity without romance.
Two adult figures, equal scale, heads fully inside upper45%, no third main human, lighting links the pair into one coherent painting. Preserve the two separate identities, never merge facial features.
Keep ALL important anatomy, weapon heads/tips and animal faces within CENTRAL80% of canvas (x10%..90%), not merely inside the outer edge. Leave side columns as background or unimportant cloak only. Place all hands/gesture and spell motifs above y52%; nothing bright or complex below y60%.
Make the shared magical motif SMALL, between both faces and upper chests, entirely x25%..75%, y25%..45%. Both faces inside central70%, hands naturally held near chests, no limb pointing at any side edge. Bottom45% quiet deep blue-black cloak and shadow. Omit unrelated weapons and animals from the portrait references.
